dct_title_s: Preliminary satellite-derived reservoir assessment, Benghazi, Almarj & Derna governorates, East province, Libya - 19 September 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20230912LBY, GDACS Id: 1102204** Status: increased water observed Further action(s): continue monitoring Wadi Qattarra Dam 1 & 2 appears to be filled as of 16 September 2023; Wadi Jaza dam appears to be filled as of 15 September 2023; Increased water observed in Al Marj dam as of 15 September 2023; Both Derna dams destroyed by rushing flood waters.
